overview: LatticeWorks, Inc. is a small-business technology company supporting public-sector missions through custom software, systems integration, cloud and data platforms, cybersecurity, and ongoing IT operations and maintenance.
capabilities:
Custom web application design and development
Application modernization and systems integration
Cloud architecture, migration, hosting, and operations
DevSecOps, automation, and secure software delivery
Cybersecurity and zero-trust implementation support
Data engineering, analytics, AI, and decision-support solutions
IT systems operations, maintenance, sustainment, and user support
Technical program, product, and engineering support
differentiators: Combines hands-on software engineering with practical operations and sustainment experience. Able to support the full application lifecycle from discovery and architecture through delivery, security, modernization, integration, and O&M. Focused on mission outcomes, usable systems, and maintainable solutions for federal customers.
target_agencies: Department of Defense, Department of Education, Department of Energy, Department of Health and Human Services, Department of State, Department of the Air Force, Department of the Army, Department of the Navy, Department of Veterans Affairs
set_aside_eligibility: Total Small Business Set-Aside, Partial Small Business Set-Aside, 8(a) Set-Aside, 8(a) Sole Source
positive_keywords: custom software, web application, application development, application modernization, systems integration, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, zero trust, data engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, IT support, operations and maintenance, O&M, sustainment
negative_keywords: hardware-only purchase, commodity resale, software license only, brand-name sole source, construction, facilities maintenance
